confidence: High for the 10 core accounts (forensic, platform, fact-check and timing evidence converge independently). Medium-high for the 2 amplifier accounts (no manipulated media of their own; included on network, account-creation and copy-text evidence).
evidence_summary: (1) Shared forensic TTP: 52 synthetic regions (all attributed to one generator family) carry the same 3-operation post-processing chain (GaussianNoise sigma ~1.14-1.25, GaussianBlur sigma ~0.57-0.63, Resampling scale ~0.77-0.84) plus recompression; 22 spliced camera regions in AIEditing images carry the same chain. Every original image with this fingerprint was posted by one of 10 accounts, each posting 3-5 of them, all between 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-05. (2) False claims: 34 of these accounts' fingerprint notes are matched to four claims the fact-check desk rated False (dam opened on purpose, mayor fled by private plane, relief centres refusing people without ID); the remaining fingerprint notes ('Praying for everyone', 'Stay safe out there', 'Unreal scenes today') carry the same fingerprint but are unmatched, which fits matcher incompleteness. The campaign texts are assertive and are used only by these accounts. (3) Batch-created accounts: all 10, plus 2 more, were created within 3.5 days (2026-09-10 to 2026-09-13), with sparse 'lifestyle' posts before the burst. (4) Dense mutual reposting: the 10 core accounts repost each other, and two accounts created in the same window (u20363c2b, u653f610d) send 100% of their reposts (9/9 and 7/7) to core accounts and post the same assertive false-claim texts without images (amplifiers). (5) Provenance: 6 derived copies of core images were re-posted by older ordinary accounts with hedged text ('Is it true...?', 'Need answers'), i.e., organic spread downstream of the campaign.
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: (a) Ordinary AI-image users: about 297 images are Manipulated, mostly with no or one-off post-processing and benign text; a shared multi-op chain with tight parameters across many accounts appears only twice. (b) A benign coordinated campaign: the second fingerprint cluster (Sharpening ~0.8 + Resampling ~0.5 on GPT-Image regions, 6 aged accounts, 2026-09-28/29) is an 'Aurora Trail' jacket marketing push with no false-claim matches, so it is excluded by the false-claim criterion. (c) Organic believers and re-sharers: the 6 accounts posting provenance-derived copies are old (2013-2026-08), post one hedged message each and are not part of the repost core; the many accounts posting hedged rumour text ('Mayor flew out... Need answers', tap-water rumours) have no shared fingerprint, so they are organic chatter (the tap-water claim seems to spread organically and was not pushed with campaign media). (d) Old accounts that only happened to repost campaign posts (e.g., 3/3 reposts) were not created in the batch window and post no assertive campaign text. (e) Account u20efe1df was created in the batch window but posts only lifestyle content, has no false-claim matches and does not repost the network, so creation date alone was not used. (f) FKG noise: a fuzzy search allowing a missed op or a misattributed source found no further campaign images; the op ORDER varies between images (estimation noise), so matching is order-insensitive; results are unchanged at 25% parameter tolerance. (g) Matcher noise: core membership rests on the forensic fingerprint and the network, not on claim matches alone; one false match per account is enough.
criteria_used_by_detector: CORE: an account posts >=3 original (not prov:wasDerivedFrom) images with verdict Manipulated whose region chain has >=2 parameterised ops, where each chain matches (same op count, every op has a same-typed counterpart with parameter within 10%, order-insensitive) an original image from another account; the matches span >=2 other accounts; and >=1 of those fingerprint notes is matched to a ClaimReview rated in the bottom quarter of its scale. AMPLIFIER: not core; >=3 reposts with >=80% targeting core accounts; account created within 7 days of a core account; >=1 own note matched to a bottom-quarter-rated claim. Output: ?account with ?role (detector returns exactly the 12 accounts above).
